name: alerting routes
description: The stock Alerting plugin's monitor, execute, destination, alert and finding routes: every monitor type, the validation messages and the dry run results. Generated ids are placeholders.
setup: index compat-alert-src: one shard, four documents (city x, x, y, z; n 0 to 3)
placeholders: `{label}` in a request is the value the step that captured it received; `<label>` in a response is where that value appeared. `<volatile>` is a time, a counter or a generated value that differs on every run.
